profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Community CareLink
profile.summary: Highly accomplished Senior Software Engineer and Team Lead with 5+ years of experience in full-stack development, project leadership, and infrastructure management. Proven ability to drive innovation, mentor team members, and implement strategic workflows to boost team efficiency and reduce operational waste. Expert in C#/.NET, Angular/Blazor, and modern containerization technologies

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Kansas City, Missouri, United States · Hybrid
positions.description: Skills: Software Design · Software Infrastructure · Software Development

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer Team Lead
positions.locationName: Kansas City, Kansas, United States · On-site
positions.description:
•	Spearheaded the complete re-architecture and rewrite of  mission-critical enterprise-level                          applications in an aggressive six-month timeline, resulting in a quantifiable increase in end-user workflow efficiencies exceeding 100%.
•	Developed and integrated applications using our in-house AI, successfully programming these applications to identify patients requiring follow-up for various diseases, which significantly contributed to life-saving efforts.
•	Functioned as a key strategic partner, regularly contributing to executive-level meetings to shape product roadmaps, application workflows, and strategic sales tactics.
•	Promoted to Team Lead, where I instituted operational excellence, streamlined workflows, created detailed quarterly roadmaps, and organized all major applications into strategic, staggered release cycles.
•	Built, maintained, and optimized automated CI/CD pipelines using Azure, Github, and Argo to deploy       containerized applications in cloud environments.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
•	Collaborated with the leadership team to determine company direction and innovation.
•	Created and implemented new management and organizational workflows to boost efficiency and  reduce waste.
•	Continued active development and programming of applications.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Converted VBA workbook macros to a C# based web interface. 
•	Designed user interfaces and met with clients to fulfill operational needs. 
•	Designed and maintained a REST based API with high efficiency.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
•	Developed Xamarin based mobile app for both iOS and Android capable of video and audio communication.
•	Created new web application for streaming internal recordings for quality assurance evaluation. 
•	Mentored new employees to allow them to better acclimate to our environment and provided guidance in development practices and techniques.
•	Lead a company project and maintained communication with stakeholders to deliver features upon request.
•	Created new environments within virtual containers for production use.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · SQL · Microsoft Azure · Angular · Xamarin Products

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Designed and programmed new agile tool for the work-from-home environment using SQL database, Java, and JavaScript. 
•	Practiced full stack development in creating new applications for internal use.
•	Used agile development process to practice effective communication and to produce timely code.

positions.title: IT Contractor
positions.description:
•	Re-designed company app for a more ergonomic design, and verified multiple bugs creating a more stable app.
•	Increased client numbers through demonstrations and support calls, breaking through the 1000th customer threshold. 
•	Supported multiple clients in one-on-one meetings to exceed customer needs and adding features as per customer request.

positions.title: Administrative Assistant - School of Social Work
positions.description:
•	Designed and created department’s website drastically decreasing student inquiries on application processes and graduation requirements.
•	Managed over 170 student files and ensured student graduation through application review and submission. 
•	Walked multiple students through application processes bringing in at least 20 students per semester to the program.

volunteerExperiences.companyName: St. Louis African Arts Festival - Safari Teens
volunteerExperiences.description:
•	Managed and created volunteer events for the African Arts Festival
•	Designed and maintained website and content
•	Led and directed members in task, events, and meetings improving the committee and setting a precedent for future committee chairs.

company.name: St. Louis African Arts Festival - Safari Teens
